description: Betty Kowalski formally escalates her pending small business stabilization grant application (originally filed tick 2) by delivering documentation in person to Maria Santos's office. She cites the newly lowered 10% revenue decline threshold for auto row businesses and requests a specific disbursement timeline within five business days. Her diner has gone from reduced revenue to zero income — well past the 10% threshold — and her application predates the threshold change, making it eligible under the revised criteria.
